title: Rabbitmq messaging topology operator: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object… (CVE-2026-116587)
description: CVE-2026-116587 affects multiple packages. Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of standards in Go, including support for JSON Web Encryption (JWE), JSON Web Signature (JWS), and JSON Web Token (JWT) standards. See references for individual vulnerability details.
